title: Kula Ag Park expansion and new farm reservoir
summary: A contract for a new reservoir and 12-inch water line at Kula Ag Park was recently awarded, and the agriculture director said it will be built before a second park phase of about 24 lots. The reservoir would use almost all the money received so far and will give the 31 leased lots more efficient water flow. A second phase will need more funding.
